Things break silently, and nobody can trace why, because nobody documented what was actually there to begin with

Code review is dead. Spec review is where quality lives now. But spec review only works if the spec is grounded in reality, not guesswork.

## What EasySpecs does

Two things, one workflow:

1. We document your codebase automatically

Even the undocumented, nobody-wants-to-touch-it kind. Our first real test was a pharmaceutical company's legacy Delphi system. If it works there, it works on whatever you're building.

2. We turn that understanding into specs your team and your agents can actually trust

Every spec comes paired with validators, so you know it matches the app before anyone codes against it. [...] ### Top forum threads

Hey Product Hunt 👋

I'm Xesca, CTO turned founder. Before EasySpecs, I spent 15+ years being the person accountable for code I didn't personally write, across fintech, insurtech, and media.

That's the job now for every engineering leader: your agents ship code faster than anyone can read it, and you're still the one who answers for what breaks.

## The problem

I kept hitting the same wall everywhere I looked:

Teams adopt AI coding agents, and PRs pile up faster than anyone can review them

Specs get written against a mental model of the codebase, not the actual codebase

Agents generate code against those specs [...] Here's the part I'm most proud of: as you write a spec, the specs crafter suggests oracles and rubrics for it, concrete, checkable ways to verify the change actually did what the spec said.

Oracles — the "does this pass or fail" checks a machine can run

Rubrics — the judgment calls that need a human or an AI reviewer to score against clear criteria

You're not staring at a blank page trying to guess how to verify your own spec. The tool proposes it alongside the spec itself.

## Built for more than developers

You don't need to be a developer to use it. Right now the only way to sanity-check a spec against reality is to go read the source yourself.

We built EasySpecs so product managers and team leads get that confidence without opening a single file.

# Introducing EasySpecs: the Spec Review Platform

AI is accelerating how fast software changes. EasySpecs helps teams share a trustworthy product story—document the real system, polish intent, and trust specs before the next change lands.

Product introduction from the EasySpecs team.

Custom cover illustration for Introducing EasySpecs: the Spec Review Platform

Software is changing faster than teams can keep a shared understanding of what they already built. Coding agents multiply that speed. Without a living source of truth for intent and how the system works today, every change is a guess.

EasySpecs is the Spec Review Platform for that gap.

## What EasySpecs does [...] ## What EasySpecs does

EasySpecs turns real repositories into reviewable specifications your whole team can use—not only engineers in an IDE:

 From code to documentation — generate and maintain structured specs grounded in the codebase.
 Spec review — polish intent, catch gaps early, and agree before implementation churn.
 Living product story — one place builders edit and everyone else can read.

## Who it is for

 Tech leaders who need trustworthy specs before the next release or agent-driven change.
 Product and engineering teams practicing Spec-Driven Development (SDD).
 Organizations adopting agentic coding who still need humans to own the seed of intent.
